about: Known differences between server/schema.sql and its copies (F-33). May only shrink: the check fails on a difference not listed here, on an entry that no longer matches a difference, and (with --ratchet) on an entry the base commit's copy of this file does not have. Every group needs a reason. README.md explains the keys.

groups.reason: server/src/db.js ensureSchema() creates only the tables added after the original schema. The base tables come from server/schema.sql alone in the test databases (CI loads it), imported_events also from the importer's ensureImportSchema(); a fresh production database is built by the Laravel migrations (api/docker/entrypoint.sh runs migrate), not by db.js. Open part of F-33, not fixed in PR 1.

seed.js's ban_evidence retrofit predates the source column. The column is not lost: db.js ensureSchema(), which runs on every server start, adds ban_evidence.source at the reference's position (the db.js alter pass compares it without a difference).

Stock Laravel skeleton tables for sessions and queues. Laravel's skeleton migrations create them (also the `migrate` of api/docker/entrypoint.sh), but nothing uses them: the deploy runs Laravel with SESSION_DRIVER=array and QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync (deploy/docker-compose.yml). (The cache tables are in server/schema.sql since the deploy uses CACHE_STORE=database.)
Laravel's own migration ledger, created by `php artisan migrate` itself; it is not part of the application schema.
